hyp_2f55e40cfae4.title: Given the absence of a defined trend lifecycle or dominant signal in the deterministic angle analysis, the strategy should adopt a mean-reversion approach within a low-volatility, range-bound regime; specifically, utilize the 20-period and 50-period Exponential Moving Averages to define the dynamic boundaries of the trading channel, entering long positions when price touches the lower channel boundary with a RSI(14) reading below 30, and exiting when price reverts to the 20-period EMA, while employing a tight stop-loss at the recent swing low to mitigate risk during potential regime shifts.
